description:
Two README inconsistencies found in the 2026-10-09 review:
1. README.md line 16 says "Needs Elixir ≥ 1.18" but mix.exs declares `elixir: "~> 1.20"`, and the examples' Mix.install path inherits that. Either lower mix.exs to the real minimum (JSON is stdlib from 1.18, which Defk.Bench uses; check nothing else needs 1.20 by compiling under 1.18 if available) or change the README to ≥ 1.20. The Results table already says "Elixir 1.20".
2. The "Piece | File" table under "What it is" omits lib/defk/bench.ex (measurement and the DEFK_RESULT line), lib/defk/builtins.ex (the builtin list shared by the compiler, Elixir mode and the errors), lib/defk/test.ex + lib/defk/ex_unit/case.ex (agreement helpers), lib/defk/divergences.ex (see its own ticket) and test/support/generators.ex.

Done when: README and mix.exs state the same minimum Elixir version, and the file table lists every module under lib/ with one line each.
title: README: Elixir version requirement contradicts mix.exs; file table incomplete
